children: Food-technology platform Wonder unveiled Wonder Create, a new platform allowing users to launch restaurant concepts and brands and said Netflix would be among the founding creators.
Wonder Create creators and brands would craft the menu and build the brand, while Wonder's team would deal with the food-production process, the company said Tuesday.
The company said dishes from the creators' restaurants would be instantly available across Wonder, Grubhub and Seamless.
Wonder said its partnership with Netflix is for a branded restaurant concept that would feature custom menu items inspired by the streaming service's series and movies.
Other participants will include Andy Cohen and Jim Gaffigan, while restaurants like Chopt Creative Salad will use Wonder Create to test new dishes, Wonder said.

The platform's namesake locations offer multiple cuisines, including brands based on acclaimed restaurants such as Brooklyn's Di Fara Pizza and offerings from prominent chefs such as Streetbird by Marcus Samuelsson.
The company's operations include Grubhub and Blue Apron, and this year it bought New York restaurants Blue Ribbon Fried Chicken and Salt Hank's.

Wonder, founded by former Walmart executive Marc Lore, said on Nov. 5 that it confidentially filed for an initial public offering. The company said in July that it raised $650 million of Series D financing at a pre-money valuation of $9 billion.
